# BioPharma Radar

Public healthcare and biotech news. Static, read-only JSON. No authentication.
Send a descriptive User-Agent header such as YourNewsReader/1.0 when using
scripts. Cloudflare may reject generic default Python user agents with HTTP 403.

- [Company catalog](data/companies.json)
- [Company news example: Lilly](data/companies/us-lly.json)
- [All news](data/latest.json)
- [Hong Kong](data/markets/hk.json)
- [US](data/markets/us.json)
- [Industry news](data/markets/global.json)
- [AI briefing](data/briefing.json)
- [RSS](data/feed.xml)
- [OpenAPI](openapi.json)

Filter locally; query strings do not filter. Preserve source URLs.
Timestamps are Unix seconds in UTC. Null published_at means unknown publication
time; first_seen_at is discovery time. Markets are heuristic and can overlap.
Check last_success_at and collection_status. AI briefings are not independently
verified. This is partial source coverage, not an exhaustive market feed.

Sources: BioPharma Dive, the Fierce Biotech Biotech section, and official releases
from Lilly, Amgen, Regeneron and Vertex. US coverage is
the priority; Hong Kong coverage is partial. GLOBAL includes unidentified
companies and other listing markets. The A-share endpoint is retired.

Company IDs are stable registry keys. Use data/companies/{company_id}.json for
precomputed company news; zero-news companies return an empty items array.
Catalog coverage and news coverage differ. US categories are biotechnology and
drug manufacturing, cross-checked against Nasdaq Trader securities files. HK
is a reviewed initial subset checked against the HKEX securities list. Catalog
verification dates are explicit; coverage is not exhaustive or real-time.
Prefer title_zh and summary_zh for Chinese reading; title and excerpt retain
original source text. translation.status may be pending when free APIs fail or
hit their shared daily limits. Never infer extra facts from a short excerpt.
